scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/worker.mjs && esbuild src/parser.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/parser.mjs && esbuild src/scheduler.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/scheduler.mjs && esbuild tests/bench.worker.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/bench.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test tests/parser.test.mjs tests/scheduler.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test tests/workerd.test.mjs tests/scheduler-workerd.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run dry-run && npm run test:benchmark
